200.description: One result per operation, in order. 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE above 50 operations or 512 KB; 401/403 when the session, device or membership no longer allows writing to the Space.
409 RESYNC_REQUIRED when the cursor is ahead of the Space or older than the offline horizon.
Spaces with an ACTIVE membership; INITIALIZING ones only for their creator.

201.description: Creates the Space INITIALIZING with default roles and the caller as owner; a retry by the creator answers the same. 409 ID_COLLISION when the id belongs to someone else.

200.description: All-or-nothing per chunk. Errors carry fields.chunk_id + fields.index (+ records.<i>.<field>).
422 COUNT_MISMATCH per type keeps the Space INITIALIZING.
Waiting requests on this invite become REJECTED.
404 INVITE_INVALID for unknown, revoked, expired or used-up invites.
Caller must be a Family guardian of the requester.
409 INVITE_INVALID when the invite expired, was revoked or is used up.

actorId.description: Actor id generated by the client; stable across mode upgrades.

current.description: True for the device making this request.

csrfToken.description: Echo in the X-CSRF-Token header on every write request.

base_revision.description: Server revision the edit started from; null on create.

payload.description: Full record (camelCase, frontend schema) for create/update/occurrence_action; null for delete.

client_created_at.description: ISO instant of the user action; informational only.

operations.description: At most 50 operations and 512 KB per request.

record.description: APPLIED: canonical record as the caller may see it (null after delete or when no longer readable).

current.description: REVISION_CONFLICT / FORBIDDEN: current server record if the caller may read it, else null.

seq.description: change_seq of the entry, as a string.

revision.description: UPSERT: revision of `record`; DELETE: revision of the delete.

record.description: UPSERT only: current record (camelCase, frontend schema) as the caller may see it.

changes.description: Only entries the caller may read now, latest per record.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` next time; advances past hidden entries too.

policy_version.description: Differs from the cached value: reload the snapshot and drop records missing from it.

watermark.description: change_seq the snapshot reflects; pull changes from here.

records.description: Every live record the caller may read, keyed by resource type (space_settings excluded).

id.description: The local Space id; kept as the server id.

payload.description: Same payload as a sync create.

chunk_id.description: Client UUID; resending the same chunk is a no-op.

expected_counts.description: Records uploaded per resource type (system roles excluded); omitted types count as 0.

self_member_id.description: The uploaded Member that is the creator (SELF link).

watermark.description: change_seq after activation; equals the snapshot watermark.

proposed_role.description: Role key suggested to the approver (not OWNER/ORGANIZER).

email.description: Addressee; the invite then shows in their GET /me/invitations.

token.description: Shown once; only its hash is stored.

member_id.description: Existing Member the requester says they are.
Link to this existing Member (exclusive with new_member).

new_member.description: Create a Member for the requester (exclusive with member_id).
